_comment: Labeled negotiation-tactic examples for the classifier ablation (spec 6). Labels use the canonical taxonomy in config.TACTICS; compound labels join parts with '+'. A prediction counts correct if it matches ANY part of the gold label. Written to be realistic (not overfit to the rules) — some examples are deliberately subtle so rules-only misses them and the ablation is meaningful.

examples.message: That's my final offer — take it or leave it.
